coordinateSystem: top-left origin; x right; y down
buttonMotion: 0 = down/alarm off; 1 = up/alarm armed. Cap translates y = -36 * progress; skirt expands to stationary seat.
greenMark: Printed ellipse: centre (626.5,151.5) at rest; radii (25,4.5); translates with cap.
buttonWell: Static opaque vector recess covers the original flush button baked into the shared body.
handReference: All hand SVGs point to 12 at zero degrees; rotate clockwise about (627,677).

transition.method: actual vector translation and sidewall reveal

quality: Single fixed raster body/dial; all hands and button geometry are editable SVG vectors. Full clock is hybrid, not entirely vector.
